snapshot.title: Empires on the eve of war
snapshot.description: A schematic prewar reference. British India combines directly ruled areas and princely states; the map does not distinguish their internal boundaries. Status could change within 1914.
snapshot.note: The candidate 1945 map is rejected for anachronistic identities and control fields. No 1947 partition boundary is inferred from this 1914 reference.
